units.rawText: Mayushii is Okarin's hostage. The day Mayushii lost Mayushii's granny... Mayushii felt like Mayushii was going to disappear. But Okarin said, "You must remain in this world." That's why Mayushii is here today.

units.rawText: Although Mayushii doesn't know why, Mayushii knows you're like that too.

units.rawText: I'm sure many important people here were saved because of you. Perhaps Mayushii was saved by the Professor in another Oasis, or another world entirely. Mayushii will support the Professor forever.
